name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Aegis Emplacement AE-6 'Bulwark'
description:
A heavy emplaced weapon system designed for fixed-position defense. The Bulwark fires 10mm tungsten-core rounds from a dual-barrel configuration at 800 rounds per minute, with an integrated shield generator that projects a localized kinetic barrier in front of the firing position.

The AE-6 weighs 85 kg and requires mounting on a prepared position — rooftop, vehicle, or reinforced tripod. Once emplaced, the weapon's shield generator creates a 2-meter wide energy barrier that deflects small-arms fire while allowing the operator to engage threats from behind cover that did not exist before deployment.

Arcturus designed the Bulwark for corporate checkpoint defense and corridor denial. The combination of sustained heavy fire and projected shielding makes a single AE-6 position functionally equivalent to a fortified bunker — deployable in under three minutes and relocatable as tactical needs change.
legality: Military restricted — emplaced weapons authorization required
specifications:
caliber: 10mm tungsten-core
effective_range: 100-1,200 meters
rate_of_fire: 800 rounds per minute (dual barrel combined)
capacity: 400-round linked belt
weight: 85 kg (weapon and shield generator)
power_source: Shield: portable fusion cell, 2 hours continuous projection
tactical_use: The Bulwark transforms any position into a hardened defensive point. Corporate security teams deploy AE-6 units at choke points during building lockdowns, perimeter breaches, and territorial disputes. The shield generator's kinetic barrier stops conventional small-arms fire but is transparent to directed energy weapons — a known vulnerability that attackers exploit by mixing kinetic and energy weapons in their assault elements.
cultural_context: The sight of a Bulwark being deployed signals that a corporate entity has decided to hold ground at any cost. In GLMZ's ongoing territorial disputes, the AE-6 has become synonymous with escalation — its presence means negotiations have failed and the corporation is prepared for siege warfare. Lower-tier communities caught between competing Bulwark positions have learned to evacuate when they see the distinctive shield shimmer.
story_hooks: A Bulwark position was overrun when its shield generator was defeated by a weapon no one can identify — the barrier simply vanished. Arcturus is offering a reward for information about the counter-shield technology.

Someone is deploying stolen Bulwark units in the lower tiers, creating fortified positions that municipal security cannot breach. A community has declared independence behind a wall of Arcturus hardware.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist, angular heavy weapon system dominated by twin barrel assemblies mounted on a reinforced rotary base. The silhouette suggests industrial strength—all sharp lines, vented housings, and purposeful bulk. It reads as mounted artillery shrunk to squad-level scale, with a distinctive shield-generator module protruding from the rear like an exhaust manifold.
physical_description.dimensions: Main body 145 cm long, 78 cm wide, 62 cm tall at rest. Dual barrels extend 110 cm forward from the mounting plate. Shield generator module 45 cm × 38 cm × 28 cm, mounted offset on right side of frame.
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial and planted—85 kg total gives the system a gravity-locked feeling, designed for stability under sustained fire. Moves deliberately, resists recoil through sheer mass rather than electronics.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced steel frame with carbon-composite barrel shrouds. Shield generator casing is brushed titanium-aluminum alloy. Ammunition feed system uses industrial-grade polymer and hardened steel.
physical_description.finish: Battle-worn dark oxide steel with heavy-use patina. Composite shrouds show matte charcoal with lighter wear marks on contact points. The shield generator housing has a burnt-bronze finish from thermal cycling. Abundant tool marks and mounting scratches suggest field modification history.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal and steel gray primary, with burnt-copper accents on the shield generator module. Ammunition belt glints dull brass in ambient light.
physical_description.grip_texture: No traditional grip—operator controls via pintle mount handles (reinforced aluminum, textured with anti-slip knurling) and rotary adjustment wheels. Feels industrial, mechanical, designed for gloved operation.
distinctive_features: Twin barrel clusters with independently articulated heat vents—concentric rings of cooling louvers
Prominent rectangular shield generator module with visible cooling fins and a faintly glowing power coupling (soft blue LED when active)
Ammunition feed mechanism with exposed belt guide showing 400-round linked tungsten rounds
Rotary pintle mount with 360-degree traverse gearing and degree markings
Tactile feedback displays (five small circular LED status lights) on the left side of the mounting frame
Thermal bleed ports along barrel shrouds, blackened from repeated thermal cycling
Reinforced tripod quick-release lock mechanism, heavily scored from field deployment cycles
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo stamped into the shield generator housing (top-right). Serial plate mounted vertically on left rail showing designation 'AE-6 BULWARK' and a 16-digit registration code. Blackwood Commercial Group subsidiary mark micro-etched near the ammunition feed.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-ready, well-maintained but showing honest wear. Barrels retain their dark oxide coating but with minor carbon scoring. The shield generator module shows thermal cycling marks. Mounting points are scuffed from tripod repositioning. Ammunition belt shows no corrosion—regularly cycled and maintained. Overall impression: a weapon that's been deployed and will be deployed again, kept functional but without cosmetic concern.
